research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Form Energy is researching iron-air and metal-air electrochemical cells and bulk energy storage for the electric grid. Work such as “Electrode configurations for iron-air electrochemical systems,” “Additive for iron-air batteries,” “Low cost metal electrodes,” “Metal air electrochemical cell architecture,” and “Refuelable battery for the electric grid and method of using thereof” focuses on iron electrodes, gas diffusion electrodes, alkaline electrolytes, refuelable designs, and grid-scale battery system architectures.

overview_description.description: Form Energy is an energy technology and manufacturing company that develops multi-day energy storage systems for electric grids. Its first commercial product is an iron-air battery system designed to store and discharge electricity for up to 100 hours. The company also develops Formware, grid modeling software for evaluating energy storage and power system designs.
